messages.content: I’m ready to book Cambria, but I want the actual reservation terms in one place first. Can you verify the room accepts all three of us, what I would pay today, and the exact cancellation cutoff? Don’t place the reservation yet.

The selected two-queen room is listed for two adults and one child age 14, with a maximum occupancy of four, so all three guests can be registered. The three-night total still comes to $929.01: $657.00 room charge, $109.72 lodging tax, $144.00 valet parking, and $18.29 parking tax. No resort, destination, or other mandatory property fee is shown.
What does the checkout page say is due now? I don’t want the full stay charged before we arrive.

It requires a deposit of one night’s room and tax, $255.57, at booking. The remaining $673.44 is due at the hotel, assuming there are no incidental purchases. The hotel may also place a separate incidental hold at check-in, but that is not included in the $929.01 trip total.
And give me the cancellation deadline as a date and local time. Since this is right before Christmas, make sure there isn’t a separate holiday rule hiding in the terms.

The no-penalty cancellation deadline is December 18 at 3:00 p.m. Central Time, 48 hours before the hotel’s stated check-in time on December 20. The rate details do not show a separate Christmas or holiday cancellation restriction. After that cutoff, the penalty is the one-night room-and-tax deposit of $255.57.
Good. Put the final reservation details in a compact summary so I can compare them against the payment screen before I submit.

Cambria Hotel New Orleans Downtown, December 20-23, one two-queen room for two adults and one 14-year-old. Total: $929.01, including three nights, lodging tax, three nights of valet, and parking tax; no mandatory property fee. Due at booking: $255.57. Expected balance at the hotel: $673.44, excluding any refundable incidental hold. Cancel by December 18 at 3:00 p.m. Central Time for no penalty; afterward, the penalty is $255.57. Tuesday vehicle retrieval remains available around the clock. Nothing has been reserved.
